## Diverging Signals
- **Equity stress vs calm credit and rates.** TQQQ, VXN and the news feed say shock. HY OAS is narrowing (3.33% → 3.27%) and the 10Y fell about 19bp in a day. If that is a growth scare, it supports Stage 5. If it is a relief bid, it supports Stage 4. The data here cannot tell which.
- **Tech-only fear.** VXN is 28.72 against VIX 19.57 (about 1.47×). DJI and the Russell were flat on a −2.9% NDX day. The damage is concentrated in Nasdaq names, and the stage label reads broader than the tape.
- **Oversold vs unconfirmed.** RSI 27.5 and rich option pricing usually support put sellers. One red day with no green follow-through, plus an FOMC decision in three sessions, argue against leaning on that.
- **Gold falling with yields.** There is no safe-haven bid in gold even as the 10Y drops. This weakens the "flight to safety" explanation of the yield move.
- **Move size.** TQQQ −8.52% against NDX −2.90% is about 2.9×, in line with 3× leverage.

- Market structure: **DOWNTURN.** Spot is 22.2% below the 4-week high of $85.32 (the test is more than 20%, line $68.26) and VXN is 28.72 (the test is 25 or more). Both legs are met. Spot is only 1.2% above the 4-week low, so this is not a rally structure. The previous read said SIDEWAYS.
- Trend: Below the 50DMA ($74.23) by 10.53%, and above the 200DMA (about $64.93) by only 2.3%. The 200DMA is the last major trend line and sits 2.2% below spot. Spot is 24.28% under the 52-week high.
- Volatility & premium environment: VXN jumped 17.6% to 28.72. Chain ATM IV is 73%, up from 60% on 10-21. IV/HV 1.33 says premium is rich against realized movement, but HV20 of 55.4% may not yet fully include the 8.5% drop. VVIX 107.94 and MOVE 106.84 are both up sharply, and SKEW 152.39 still shows expensive downside protection. Premium is fat, and swings are also big (TQQQ moves about 3× NDX).
- Put-selling context: HOSTILE. Premium is rich and RSI is oversold. Against that, the structure is DOWNTURN, spot sits 1.2% above the 4-week low and 2.2% above the 200DMA, the news daemon is in SHOCK, and an FOMC decision lands inside five sessions. Gap risk is high, and the oversold bounce is unconfirmed. Context only — no strikes, expiries or sizes.
